rule:
Hard requirements:
- The picture is the display content alone, filling the whole image edge to edge: no monitor, no bezel, no device, no frame, no room around it, no curvature, no reflection.
- Very bright, as a screen at full brightness photographed straight on: vivid saturated colours, lines and shapes near full brightness, panes visibly lit, the darkest areas deep blue and not black. It must read clearly when shrunk to 300 pixels wide.
- Straight-on, flat.
- No real brand, no logo, no operating system, no readable words: any writing is tiny abstract unreadable glyphs.

body.prompt: Replace the attached blank image entirely. Draw a finished full-screen computer interface of the 2070s, as production-quality film interface design for a cyberpunk film: dense and layered, a few dozen clear elements of large and middling size, bold bright lines, translucent overlapping panes of differing sizes with fine borders and corner ticks, dials, rulers, tick marks, small gauges, glyph columns in an invented angular script at a size that can be made out, panes filled with lit deep blue, teal or amber tones, callout lines, data heat-strips, soft glow and depth. Not a sketch and not a wireframe placeholder: no empty panes and no blocks standing in for text. What it shows: A medical body scan: at the left a full standing human figure in translucent glowing cyan, skeleton and organs faintly visible, an amber spine and a magenta marker at the heart; at the right four coloured vital traces, a green heart trace, and a pane of tiny glyph rows.
